about: THE ENGINE'S LESSONS (learning part 2 of the CONTROLLER's 08:42 of 7 November 2026: 'each wrong fact gets its class (A to N) ... a test asserting the right value goes into the corpus. The corpus only grows; a fix that breaks an old lesson fails the gate'). Each lesson names the class of C:\dev\GROWTH\ENGINE-ACCURACY-7NOV.md it came from, the case, the test that asserts the right value, and words that test carries for the case. tests/unit/lessons/engine-lessons.test.ts fails if a lesson's test is gone or no longer names its case, or if the corpus falls below its floor. The floor is raised in the commit that adds a lesson and is never lowered.
